# Ken Burns Sunset Push-In

[Film](../README.md) › [Keyframes & Motion](../README.md#keyframes--motion) · `keyframes` `motion` `easing` `ken-burns` `demo-footage`

A slow eased push-in that drifts the sun to the centre of frame, the Ken Burns move on Motion scale and position keyframes.

## About

Motion scale goes from 100 % to 150 % and position from the frame centre to (950, 640) over
six seconds, so the zoom also re-frames the shot around the sun. The first keyframes of both
parameters ease out and the last ones ease in (effects.setInterpolation), so the move starts
and settles softly instead of at a constant speed. A chapter card fades in over it.
